ModMetaData.name: Lumen Stones
ModMetaData.author: KyleMHB
ModMetaData.description:
Freeze your food, speed your healing and grow crops under crystal light, long before you have electricity.
Deep in the rock lies Lumenstone, a rare mineral that holds a faint light. Infuse it with a reagent and it takes on that reagent's character for good. Herbal medicine gives Vitalite its mending, steel gives Ferrite its slow repairs, and Glacite needs nothing added and runs cold. Each stone becomes lamps, columns, pylons and furnishings that need no fuel or power.
Every stone family has a passive effect that works on its own. Most also have a stronger active effect that spends energy, which you switch on or off per fixture. Light stones draw Solar energy gathered by Sunstone, and dark stones draw Warp energy stored in Bloodstone.
All of it sits at the neolithic tech level and needs only Stonecutting, so a tribal or medieval colony can run a freezer, a grow room, a better hospital and fire suppression.
Lumenstone is scarce, so your first stones go to whatever your colony needs most. Every stone except Glacite needs its own research and a reagent, and active effects wait until you research Sunstone. The rest comes over a long game.
Glacite cools rooms. Its coolers keep a fridge at 4 C on their own, and with Solar energy they can run a freezer. Vitalite helps patients heal and resist disease in an enclosed hospital. Serenite improves rest and mood. Verdite speeds plant growth and farming, and becomes a grow light with Solar energy. Aegite thins filth and suppresses fires. Ferrite slowly repairs buildings, items and gear. With Royalty, Animastone improves meditation.
With Ideology, a life offered in place of a reagent corrupts Lumenstone into Dark Stone, which works only by taking. Sacrifice at a Sacrificial altar turns Lumenstone into Dark Stone and harvests Warp energy. Bloodstone stores it, and Sanguinite, Dreadstone and Hollowstone spend it on regrowth, subjugation and endurance. With Anomaly, Hollowstone can bind a work husk.
Stones also make weapons, gear, implants and crystal prosthetics. Firefly columns add animated green light, and Epochs - Pyrinth, if installed, adds warm orange columns.
To start, gather Lumenstone from rare veins, surface stacks or traders. Research Stonecutting, build a Lumen ritual circle and infuse 10 Lumenstone with a reagent into 10 of any researched stone. Glacite needs no reagent.
Configure availability, effects and costs in Mod options. Requires Harmony. Glacite is adapted from Epochs - Pyrinth by DetVisor.
